description: The control (claude-code-stock) and treatment (claude-code-tether) agent-definition schemas describe the same agent-config input contract (claude_version, startup_args, run_args, settings_json, mcp_json) and must stay aligned EXCEPT the treatment schema intentionally adds the optional onboard boolean (per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md). A shared field changed in one schema but not the other means a config valid for one arm is invalid or misread for the other.
